read_file.description: Read a workspace text file with line numbers. Read an existing file before editing or overwriting it.

list_files.description: List one workspace directory. Directories end in /, symlinks in @.

search.description: Search for literal text within a workspace directory. Uses system ripgrep when available, with a bounded portable fallback.

todo_write.description: Record and update the complete task checklist to track multi-step implementation progress. Pass the full updated list of todos.

todo_read.description: Read the current session task checklist.

update_plan.description: Updates the task plan (Codex-compatible). Provide an optional explanation and a list of plan items, each with a step and status (pending, in_progress, completed). At most one step should be in_progress at a time.

explanation.description: Optional note explaining why the plan changed.

get_goal.description: Get the current goal for this thread, including status, budgets, token and elapsed-time usage, and remaining token budget.

create_goal.description: Create a goal only when explicitly requested by the user or system/developer instructions; do not infer goals from ordinary tasks. Set token_budget only when an explicit token budget is requested. Fails if an unfinished goal exists; use update_goal only for status.

objective.description: Required. The concrete objective to start pursuing. This starts a new active goal when no goal exists or replaces the current goal when it is complete.

token_budget.description: Positive token budget for the new goal. Omit unless explicitly requested.

update_goal.description: Update the existing goal. Set status to `paused` only at the user's explicit request to pause this goal, never on your own initiative. Set status to `complete` only when the objective has actually been achieved and no required work remains. Set status to `blocked` only when the same blocking condition has repeated for at least three consecutive goal turns and the agent cannot make meaningful progress without user input or an external-state change. Do not mark a goal complete merely because its budget is nearly exhausted or because you are stopping work.

status.description: Required. `paused` requires an explicit user request. Set to `complete` only when the objective is achieved and no required work remains. Set to `blocked` only after the same blocking condition has recurred for at least three consecutive goal turns and the agent is at an impasse.

request_user_input.description: Request user input for one to three short multiple-choice questions and wait for the response.

header.description: Short header label shown in the UI (12 or fewer chars).

question.description: Single-sentence prompt shown to the user.

description.description: One short sentence explaining impact/tradeoff if selected.

options.description: 2-3 choices. Put the recommended option first with "(Recommended)".

questions.description: Questions to show the user. Prefer 1 and do not exceed 3.

view_image.description: Attach a local image from the filesystem (PNG, JPEG, WEBP, GIF) to the conversation context so you can inspect it visually.

path.description: Local filesystem path to an image file.

exit_plan_mode.description: Use in plan mode when your implementation plan is complete. Presents the Markdown plan for user approval and exits plan mode upon approval so you can begin coding.

write_file.description: Create or overwrite a workspace UTF-8 file. Existing files must first be read. Use edit_file for small changes.

edit_file.description: Replace exact text in a previously read file. Refuses stale reads and ambiguous matches.

apply_patch.description: Apply a multi-hunk or multi-file patch ("*** Begin Patch" ... "*** Update File: <path>" / "*** Add File: <path>" / "*** Delete File: <path>" ... "*** End Patch"). Existing files must be read before patching; every hunk must match exactly once.

bash.description: Execute a POSIX bash command in the workspace (Git Bash on Windows, NOT cmd.exe). Always use POSIX syntax and /dev/null (never >nul or 2>nul). Output is bounded; do not start persistent background servers.

delegate_task.description: Delegate up to four independent research/review tasks to agents with separate context. Two run concurrently. They can only read this workspace. Include all needed context; they do not inherit this conversation. Returns reports and saved session IDs.

tasks.description: List of independent task prompts (1 to 4 tasks) to run in isolated sub-agents.

delegate_edit.description: Delegate up to four coding tasks to separate agents in this workspace. Tasks run sequentially; child writes/shell require the same approval policy. Children cannot spawn agents or access MCP. Include context and precise file ownership.

tasks.description: List of independent task prompts (1 to 4 tasks) to run in isolated sub-agents.

spawn_agent.description: Spawn a sub-agent (Codex multi-agent workflow) for a well-scoped task. Returns `{ agent_id, nickname, agent_type, status }` immediately so you can spawn multiple agents in parallel and then call `wait_agent({ targets: [agent_id] })` to collect their final reports. Available roles (`agent_type`): `explorer` (fast read-only codebase research), `worker` (coding/execution with explicit file ownership), `default`.

message.description: Initial task instructions for the new sub-agent. Include purpose, constraints, and file paths.

agent_type.description: Sub-agent role: "explorer" (fast read-only codebase exploration), "worker" (coding/execution with explicit file ownership), or "default".

nickname.description: Optional human-readable nickname for the sub-agent.

fork_context.description: When true, fork the current conversation history into the child sub-agent before sending the initial message.

model.description: Optional model override for this sub-agent.

reasoning_effort.description: Optional reasoning effort override for this sub-agent.

wait.description: When true, wait for the sub-agent to complete and return its report immediately instead of running in the background.

wait_agent.description: Wait for spawned sub-agents to reach a final status (`completed` or `errored`) and return their reports. Pass `targets: [agent_id, ...]` (or omit `targets` to wait for all active spawned agents).

targets.description: Agent IDs or nicknames to wait for. Omit to wait for all currently running sub-agents.

send_input.description: Send a follow-up message or task to an existing spawned sub-agent by `agent_id` or `nickname`, preserving its conversation history. Use `interrupt: true` to redirect work immediately, and then call `wait_agent` to collect its reply.

target.description: Agent ID or nickname to message.

message.description: Follow-up message or task instructions to send to the sub-agent.

interrupt.description: When true, interrupt the sub-agent current turn and start the new instruction immediately.

wait.description: When true, wait for the sub-agent turn to finish and return its output immediately.

close_agent.description: Close a spawned sub-agent by `target` (`agent_id` or `nickname`) when it is no longer needed and return its previous status.

target.description: Agent ID or nickname to close or resume.

resume_agent.description: Resume a previously closed sub-agent by `id` (`agent_id` or `nickname`) so it can receive `send_input` and `wait_agent` calls.

target.description: Agent ID or nickname to close or resume.

list_agents.description: List all spawned sub-agents in the current session with their IDs, nicknames, roles, and statuses.

agent_network.description: Convene a multi-agent Agent Network (Brainstorm / Council Room) where specialized personas (Architect, Researcher, Critic, Pragmatist, Security) explore the codebase, debate ideas peer-to-peer across rounds, and synthesize a consensus blueprint.

topic.description: The problem, feature idea, architecture question, or design challenge for the Agent Network to brainstorm and debate.

roles.description: Agent personas to include (default: ["architect", "researcher", "critic", "pragmatist"]). Custom role names are also supported.

rounds.description: Number of deliberation rounds (1 = independent proposals + synthesis, 2+ = cross-critique & peer debate rounds).

explore_codebase.description: When true, agents can use read-only codebase tools (read_file, list_files, search) while formulating ideas.

peer_list.description: List all agents in the Agent Network, including their nicknames, roles, statuses, and blackboard activity.

peer_send.description: Send a direct peer-to-peer message (idea, question, critique, finding) to another agent in the network by nickname/ID, or "*" to broadcast.

to.description: Target agent nickname or ID (or "*" to broadcast to all agents in the network).

message.description: Message, idea, critique, or question to send to the peer agent.

peer_broadcast.description: Post an idea, design proposal, codebase finding, or critique onto the shared Agent Network blackboard for all agents to read and build upon.

topic.description: Short title or topic for this shared blackboard entry.

message.description: Idea, proposal, finding, or critique to post on the shared Agent Network blackboard.

peer_read.description: Read direct messages sent to you by other agents and view the shared Agent Network blackboard.

include_read.description: When true, return all messages instead of only unread direct messages.

include_blackboard.description: When true, also return shared blackboard entries posted by all agents.

run_workflow.description: Execute a multi-step custom or built-in workflow (e.g. "feature-dev", "bug-hunt", "tdd-cycle", "security-audit").

name.description: Name of the workflow to execute (e.g. "feature-dev", "bug-hunt", "tdd-cycle", or a custom workflow name).

input.description: Input arguments or task description passed to the workflow ($input, $1, key=value).

list_mcp_resources.description: Lists resources provided by connected MCP servers.

list_mcp_resource_templates.description: Lists parameterized resource templates provided by connected MCP servers.

read_mcp_resource.description: Read a specific resource from an MCP server by server name and resource URI.
